    • instantiateP10X509CmpRaComponent

      public static final Function<byte[],byte[]> instantiateP10X509CmpRaComponent(Configuration configuration, BiFunction<byte[],String,byte[]> upstreamP10X509Exchange) throws Exception
      create an RA instance that can directly respond to general messages and handle certificate enrollment using p10cr as described in section "Requesting a certificate from a legacy PKI using a PKCS#10request" in Lightweight Certificate Management Protocol (CMP) Profile
      Parameters:
      configuration - RA configuration provided by embedding application. The generated RA instance will not make use of Configuration.getCkgConfiguration(String, int), Configuration.getUpstreamConfiguration(String, int), Configuration.getForceRaVerifyOnUpstream(String, int), and Configuration.getRetryAfterTimeInSeconds(String, int) because central key generation, upstream CMP messages, and delayed delivery are not supported here.
      upstreamP10X509Exchange - function to send ASN.1 DER-encoded PKCS#10 CSR upstream and return the resulting ASN.1 DER-encoded X.509 certificate. The second argument is the certificate profile extracted from the CMP request header generalInfo field or null if no certificate profile was specified. Asynchronous transfer and therefore delayed delivery (polling) according to the CMP profile is not supported here. Must return null if did not receive a response after relatively short timeout. Must throw an exception with a suitable message text in case the application-level request processing results in an error or the upstream server responded with an error. May throw an exception on any other (non-recoverable) error.
      Returns:
      function to use by the embedding application to deliver an ASN.1 DER-encoded CMP request from the downstream interface to the RA instance and to obtain the related ASN.1 DER-encoded CMP response for further delivery towards the end entity.
      Throws:
      Exception - in case of invalid configuration
